entries.name: GPIO_read
entries.description: Reads the digital input state from a GPIO pin using digitalRead() and prints the switch status to the Serial Monitor.

sections.description:
port: The GPIO pin used to read the digital input signal.
INPUT_PULLUP: Configures the pin as an input with the internal pull-up resistor enabled.
Returns HIGH (1) or LOW (0) depending on the switch state. In this example, HIGH prints "Switch pressed" and LOW prints "Switch released".

entries.name: digitalOutput
entries.description: Controls a device connected to a GPIO pin using digital output. The pin GPIOA_NUM_11 is configured as OUTPUT and the state is changed using digitalWrite() to turn the device ON or OFF.

sections.description:
port: The GPIO pin used for digital output.
OUTPUT: Configures the pin as an output pin.
HIGH: Sets the pin voltage HIGH to turn the connected device ON.
LOW: Sets the pin voltage LOW to turn the connected device OFF.
These functions do not return any value. They only change the digital state of the selected GPIO port.

entries.name: ADC_read
entries.description: Reads the analog input value from GPIOA_NUM_15 using analogRead() and prints the value to the Serial Monitor.

sections.description:
port: The GPIO pin configured as an analog input.
INPUT: Configures the pin as an input to read the analog signal.
Returns the analog value read from the pin. The value range depends on the ADC resolution of the board.

entries.name: analogOutput
entries.description: Generates an analog-like output signal on GPIOA_NUM_15 using software PWM by controlling the duty cycle with digitalWrite().

sections.description:
dutyPercent: Duty cycle percentage (0–100) controlling signal ON time.

total_time_ms: Total duration in milliseconds for which PWM signal is generated.

GPIOA_NUM_15: The GPIO pin used for output.
This function does not return any value. It generates a PWM signal by toggling the GPIO pin HIGH and LOW.

entries.name: ultrasonicRead
entries.description: Measures distance using an ultrasonic sensor connected to GPIOA_NUM_14 by sending a trigger pulse and calculating the echo pulse duration.

sections.description:
Define the ultrasonic pin before starting the program:

#define ULTRASONIC_PIN GPIOA_NUM_14

ULTRASONIC_PIN: The GPIO pin used for both trigger and echo signal.

pin: GPIO pin connected to ultrasonic sensor.
state: HIGH to measure echo pulse.
timeout: Maximum wait time for pulse in microseconds.

Distance is calculated in centimeters using speed of sound.
Returns the calculated distance in centimeters. If no pulse is received within timeout, distance will be zero.

entries.name: servoOutput
entries.description: Controls a servo motor connected to GPIOB_NUM_4 using a manually generated PWM signal. The servo angle is controlled by changing the pulse width between 1000 and 2000 microseconds.

sections.description:
Define the servo pin before starting the program:

#define servoPin GPIOB_NUM_4

servoPin: The GPIO port where the servo motor control signal wire is connected.

angle: The position to rotate the servo motor, specified in degrees (0–180).

servoPin: The GPIO port connected to the servo motor signal wire.
This function does not return any value. It generates a PWM pulse that moves the connected servo motor to the specified angle.

entries.name: motorControl
entries.description: Controls a DC motor using two GPIO pins: one for direction (GPIOA_NUM_13) and one for speed control (GPIOA_NUM_12) using software PWM.

sections.description:
Define motor control pins before starting the program:

#define MotorPinPWM GPIOA_NUM_12
#define MotorPinDir GPIOA_NUM_13

MotorPinPWM: Controls motor speed using PWM.
MotorPinDir: Controls motor rotation direction.

dutyPercent: Speed control percentage (0–100).

total_time_ms: Duration to run the motor.

MotorPinPWM: GPIO pin used for PWM signal.
MotorPinDir: GPIO pin used to control direction (HIGH or LOW).
These functions do not return any value. They control motor speed and direction using GPIO signals.
